Online customer service and support in Nigeria

Fixes: unanswered messages and lost sales.

Every unanswered message is a customer who went somewhere else. Most people will not wait hours for a price or a reply.

We answer enquiries on WhatsApp, Instagram, Facebook and email on your behalf, in your tone, so customers get answers while they are still interested.

Get help with this → WhatsApp us

Signs you need it

  • Messages sit unanswered for hoursBy the time you reply, the customer has already bought elsewhere.
  • Enquiries get lost across WhatsApp, Instagram and emailNobody is sure who replied to what.
  • You answer the same questions again and againPrices, opening hours and delivery take up your whole day.

What we do

  • Replies across your channelsWhatsApp, Instagram and Facebook messages, comments and email.
  • Saved replies and FAQsQuick, consistent answers to the questions you get every day.
  • Orders, bookings and complaintsHandled to rules we agree with you, and passed to you when needed.
  • A weekly summaryWhat customers are asking, and what is costing you sales.

How it works

From first look to results.

  1. First

    We learn your business

    Prices, policies, delivery and the way you like to speak to customers.

  2. Then

    We set up replies and rules

    What we can answer ourselves, and what must come to you.

  3. Next

    We go live

    Customers start getting quick, consistent replies.

  4. Finally

    We report and improve

    A weekly summary, and updated answers as new questions come up.

Questions

Things people ask us.

Can’t see your question? Ask us directly.

What hours do you cover?

We agree cover hours with you, for example business hours, or the evenings and weekends when most of your messages arrive.

Will replies sound like us?

Yes. Replies come from your accounts in the tone we agree with you. Anything unusual is passed to you.

Do you deal with complaints?

Yes, following rules we agree in advance. Serious issues are escalated to you straight away.

Which channels do you handle?

WhatsApp, Instagram and Facebook messages and comments, and email.
